body: Reply call is hidden in transcript::stream_events by exact tool name mcp__cctg__reply (server name = SOURCE/SERVER_NAME 'cctg'), not by any mcp__*__reply suffix: another channel server's reply tool (e.g. telegram plugin) must still show. Its Result item still goes over the wire; the hub ignores results of unknown call ids.

Thinking: new StreamEvent::Thinking / wire StreamItem::Thinking{text} (older hub skips it as Other, no capability needed); cut in the pure library to 1000 graphemes + ellipsis; hub sends it as its own message '💭 text' with merge:false and flushes finished calls before it, exactly like Note. Alternative (mergeable like tool lines) rejected: the task asks for a separate message.

Thinking blocks of a record are emitted before its other blocks (decoded by a separate narrow struct, prefiltered by a substring check) instead of adding Block::Thinking to lib.rs parse: keeps /brief and /full untouched; an API response always puts thinking before text/tool_use in one content array.

First draft of e2e_thinking_shows_and_the_reply_call_does_not appended the whole turn and sent Stop before the stream showed the prompt: the answer went first (Stop before the stream ran, pre-existing path). Test now waits for '> go' like e2e_order_partial_line_and_stop_after_lines; 3/3 green after that.
